 Focker In-Law Brings Ariana Grande to the Circle of Trust Nov. 25
 Sweety High Staff 
 Nov 2, 2026
 Universal Pictures’ Focker In-Law brings Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro back together in theaters on Nov. 25, with Ariana Grande joining the Meet the Parents family.
 The fourth film in the franchise opens just before Thanksgiving, and it hits the Circle of Trust with a very formidable new member.
 ( Focker In-Law via Universal Pictures)
 In theaters: Nov. 25
 Director: John Hamburg
 Cast: Ben Stiller, Robert De Niro, Ariana Grande, Skyler Gisondo, Teri Polo, Owen Wilson and Blythe Danner
 Presented by: Universal Pictures and Paramount Pictures
 What Is Focker In-Law About?
 Greg Focker (Stiller) is still a helicopter parent to his two adult kids, and his anxieties spiral when his son Henry (Skyler Gisondo) brings home a new girlfriend, Olivia (Ariana).
 She joins the family to celebrate the 80th birthday of Greg’s intimidating father-in-law, Jack Byrnes (De Niro).
 Everyone embraces Olivia, including Jack, and Henry reveals that he plans to propose.
 Greg is certain Olivia is hiding something, so he tries to unmask her, and the rivalry between the two future in-laws escalates from an airplane to the kitchen to the bike path.
 Who Is in the Cast?
 Ben Stiller and Robert DeNiro lead the returning cast, alongside Teri Polo as Pam Focker, Owen Wilson as Kevin Rawley and Blythe Danner as Dina Byrnes.
 Ariana Grande plays Olivia, and Skyler Gisondo, best known for Superman , plays Henry.
 Beanie Feldstein joins as Greg’s daughter, Samantha, and Eduardo Franco plays her boyfriend, Eduardo.
 Also read about: 62 Gravity-Defying Lyrics From Both Wicked Films to Use as Instagram Captions 
 Who Is Making Focker In-Law ?
 John Hamburg directs the film, and he also co-wrote the three previous Meet the Parents movies.
 He wrote the screenplay from a story by himself, Ilana Glazer and Austen Earl, based on characters created by Greg Glienna and Mary Ruth Clarke.
 Jane Rosenthal, Robert De Niro, Ben Stiller, John Lesher, Jay Roach and Hamburg are producing.
 The film is a Tribeca, Red Hour, Delirious Media and Particular Pictures production.
 Watch the Focker In-Law Trailer
 The first trailer debuted at CinemaCon in April, with Ben and Robert on stage to introduce it.
 It shows Jack giving Olivia a lie detector test, and it ends with a bike race between Greg and Olivia.
 When Does Focker In-Law Come Out?
 The movie opens in theaters on Nov. 25, the day before Thanksgiving.
 It has been 16 years since Little Fockers , so fans of the franchise have been waiting a long time for another family gathering.
 With Greg and Jack at odds again and Olivia holding her own, the holiday weekend should bring plenty of awkward laughs.
